research_status: COMPLETE — all 25 episodes of Blue Exorcist Season 1 classified canon/filler/mixed. QuoteTheAnime's breakdown matched an independent aggregate search exactly: episodes 1-3 and 16-17 are mixed (blending manga content with original material), episodes 6 and 11 are standalone filler, and episodes 18-25 are the anime's own original ending — produced once the anime outpaced the manga's pace, including a Satan confrontation the manga hadn't reached yet, and explicitly ignored by the manga-faithful Kyoto Saga continuation six years later. Classified 'filler' under this project's manga-adaptation definition, matching how Fullmetal Alchemist (2003)'s analogous anime-original continuation was handled earlier in this project (a deliberate policy call, confirmed with Andreas at the time, not an oversight). No episode titles included — handled automatically by load_episodes.py's auto-backfill (#103). Complete, gap-free, non-overlapping coverage of 1-25 confirmed before writing this file.
